messages:
Noah Chen: hey team, Noah here (first week). opened a tiny docs PR and Buildkite failed on checkout with a 403. not sure if i missed an onboarding step, who should i ping?
Buildkite Bot: Build #612 (noah/docs-fix) failed · exit code 128 · logs: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/612
Noah Chen: checkout snippet: 
```
remote: HTTP Basic: Access denied
fatal: Authentication failed for 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs.git/'
```
Priya Patel: welcome! :wave: first checks: accepted org invite? added SSH key? note some pipelines use HTTPS with the org deploy token (so personal SSH keys don't help). Which pipeline did you hit?
Noah Chen: pipeline is "docs/build-and-lint". i did accept the invite and added SSH key yesterday. i can clone locally over SSH but Buildkite still errors.
Samir Rao: hey Noah, welcome! we rotated the deploy token a while back — pipelines using the org token require you to be in the eng-ci GitHub team to be covered. i'm adding you to eng-ci and the Buildkite pipeline team now.
Infra Bot: Notice: deploy token rotation 2024-07-31. Users onboarded after that need explicit team membership for pipeline checkouts.
Noah Chen: thanks. re-ran and the 403 is gone but now pip install failed with a corrupted wheel: 
```
ERROR: Could not install packages due to an OSError: [Errno 74] corrupted cached wheel
```
Priya Patel: that happened to a few folks after the base image bump. Workarounds: rerun with SKIP_PIP_CACHE=1 or use the Buildkite manual "Clear caches" option.
Samir Rao: cleared the pipeline cache and retriggered. next run progressed but the integration job hit a Postgres startup timeout: 
```
E TimeoutError: Postgres did not start after 60s
```
Noah Chen: i'm seeing a fair bit of infra flakiness on day 1 :) is there a docs-only mode to avoid heavy tests?
Priya Patel: yes — add [ci skip-heavy] in the PR title or apply the "docs-only" label and the pipeline will skip integration-heavy stages. For quick fixes you can also run the pipeline manually and set SKIP_MOCKS=1.
Samir Rao: also FYI we had intermittent slow docker pulls from our internal registry causing container startup timeouts. temporary fixes: set CI_DOCKER_PULL=1, TAG=ci-latest to force fresh images, or bump job timeout. i'm bumping the timeout for this pipeline and adding DOCKER_MAX_RETRIES=3.
Noah Chen: re-ran with docs-only label and it went green. Buildkite link: https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/614
Buildkite Bot: Build #614 (noah/docs-fix) passed · duration 5m · https://buildkite.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/builds/614
Noah Chen: huge thanks, team. quick question about GitHub Actions in other repos — do I need extra permissions to edit workflows?
Priya Patel: to edit workflows you need write access. Protected branches or restricted Actions may require a maintainer or an admin to enable the GitHub App on that repo. If a run is blocked, ping eng-infra and we'll check the repo app install and repo permissions.
Noah Chen: one last thing — sometimes Buildkite showed 404 in checkout earlier for other new hires. what's that about?
Samir Rao: 404 usually means the GitHub App install doesn't have access to the repo (or the app was installed before the repo moved). We handle that by installing the GitHub App on the repo and adding the user to the pipeline team. If you see 404, ping me or open a short issue in #eng-infra.
GitHub Apps Bot: GitHub App "Redwood CI" installed on redwood-inference/docs by Samir Rao
Noah Chen: marked "CI access" on my onboarding checklist. thanks again — saved my first-week panic :relieved:
Priya Patel: welcome aboard and congrats on the green build :tada:
